hero.title: Backoffice user guide
hero.intro1: This guide helps you use the Cyna backoffice on a daily basis. It explains the purpose of each screen and the simple steps to work efficiently, even without a technical background.
hero.intro2: It is organized according to the main backoffice menu. You can read the guide in order or go directly to the section that matches your current need.

card1.title: What is this guide for?
card1.body: It guides you through the essential actions in the backoffice: activity tracking, catalog management, commercial campaigns, account management and order tracking.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: When onboarding a new team member, before an important action, or when you want to verify a step to minimize data entry errors.

card3.title: How to read this guide effectively?
card3.li1: Start with the section that matches your immediate task.
card3.li2: Read 'What is it for?' first, then 'When to use it?'.
card3.li3: Follow the steps in order to avoid omissions.
card3.li4: Finish with the key points before confirming.

card4.title: Recommended path for beginners
card4.li1: Check the Dashboard to understand the current situation.
card4.li2: Update Products and Categories if needed.

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: The Dashboard provides a clear view of performance: sales trends, customer activity, progress against targets and general period trends.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: At the start of the day to set priorities, before a meeting, during a promotional campaign, or at the end of the week for a quick review.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li1: Read the main indicators for the current period.
card3.li5: Quickly detect a drop or spike in activity.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li5: Note 2 to 3 action priorities for the day.
card4.li6: Share these priorities with the team if needed.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li1: Do not judge a result based on a single day.
card5.li4: Distinguish a one-off signal from a lasting trend.

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: The Products section allows you to maintain a clean and reliable catalog: creating, updating, activating or removing products as needed.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: At a launch, when adjusting prices, correcting information, changing availability, or preparing a commercial operation.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li1: Add a new product to the catalog.
card3.li3: Assign the product to the correct category.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li2: Search for the product or click Add.
card4.li4: Check the product's category and status.
card4.li6: Review the product row in the list after saving.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li4: Confirm the correct status (active or not).

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: Categories organize the catalog to facilitate search, product readability and the overall consistency of the offering.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: When a new product family appears, when a category is poorly named, or when the current structure is no longer clear enough for the teams.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li4: Check the correct distribution of products.
card3.li5: Delete a category that is no longer needed.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li2: Create or select the category to modify.
card4.li5: Verify that products are classified in the right place.
card4.li6: Correct any misclassified products if needed.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li1: Avoid categories that are too similar to each other.
card5.li3: Only delete after checking linked products.
card5.li4: Maintain a stable structure over time.

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: The Promotions section is used to plan and manage commercial offers to boost sales over a specific period.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: For a seasonal campaign, a product launch, a one-off operation, or to support a quieter period.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li3: Adjust its conditions according to the commercial objective.
card3.li4: Activate, pause or stop a promotion.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li3: Enter the campaign name and period.
card4.li6: Monitor the promotion throughout its duration.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li1: Check the start and end dates.
card5.li3: Make sure the promotion remains understandable.
card5.li4: Stop finished promotions to keep a clear view.

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: This section centralizes backoffice access management: account creation, information updates and role management.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: When a new team member joins, when a role changes, during a prolonged absence, or when access needs to be adjusted.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li5: Review the list of existing accounts.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li2: Search for the person or click Add.
card4.li4: Assign the role suited to the actual need.
card4.li6: Verify that the account appears with the correct status.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li1: Only assign the necessary level of access.
card5.li3: Avoid duplicate accounts for the same person.

card1.title: What is this feature for?
card1.body: The Orders section allows you to track the entire processing cycle: viewing, status verification, detail tracking and processing actions.

card2.title: When to use it?
card2.body: To process the day's orders, respond to a customer request, check an anomaly, or prioritize urgent cases.

card3.title: Main available actions
card3.li4: Open the detail to verify information.
card3.li5: Update tracking according to the situation.

card4.title: Simple steps to use it
card4.li4: Check customer information and current status.
card4.li6: Confirm that the final status is properly updated.

card5.title: Key points to watch
card5.li1: Process the most urgent orders first.
card5.li3: Keep regular track of pending statuses.
card5.li4: Make sure every action is properly confirmed.
